facts.business: Transindia Real Estate Limited is a diversified real estate and infrastructure development company engaged in investing, developing, owning, leasing and managing logistics parks, warehousing infrastructure, commercial office spaces, Container Freight Stations (CFS), Inland Container Depots (ICD) and Private Freight Terminals (PFT).

capacity_or_capex.item: Acquisition of rights and interests in Target Companies from promoter group companies
Payment made towards acquisition of Target Companies
Additional payment as advance towards land acquisition to Target Companies and promoters
Purchase of Investment Property through wholly owned subsidiary AGL Warehousing Private Limited
Acquisition of 36,670 sq. ft. premium commercial office space at Privilon, Andheri, Mumbai
Development commencement at 52.3-acre Mubarikpur Private Freight Terminal (PFT) project

Merger approvals pending from NCLT for Madanahatti Logistics and Industrial Parks Private Limited and for Avvashya Inland Park Private Limited, Dankuni Industrial Parks Private Limited, Avvashya Projects Private Limited
facts.related_party_note: Acquisition of rights and interests in Target Companies from promoter group companies (Gorsai Logistics Park Private Limited, Dighanta Landscape Private Limited, Panchghara Landscape Private Limited, Panchghara Logistics Parks Private Limited, PCPL Industrial & Logistic Park (Hoskote) Private Limited) and promoter group companies (Talentos Entertainment Private Limited and Talentos Warehousing and Industrial Parks Private Limited) for total purchase consideration of Rs 27,778 lakhs. Paid Rs 16,158 lakhs to promoter group companies during previous year. Additional payment of Rs 4,479 lakhs as advance towards land acquisition to Target Companies and promoters after reporting period. Purchase of Investment Property through wholly owned subsidiary AGL Warehousing Private Limited from Allnet Financial Services Private Limited, Sealand Cranes Private Limited, Talentos (India) Private Limited and Avash Builders & Infrastructure Private Limited for Rs 10,730 lakhs during previous year. Allotment of equity shares by Allcargo Group Services Private Limited to Allcargo Global Limited, Allcargo Logistics Limited and Allcargo Terminals Limited (promoter group entities) on July 01, 2026, reducing Company's shareholding from 100% to 25%.
